messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up 1: we need a compact claim + handoff protocol for SI + marketplace leads before next week's co-announce. We keep getting overlap and lost demo invites.
James Park: Agree. Can we define who owns the outbound invite vs who owns pipeline nurture?
Tia Gomez: Quick proposal: SI owns discovery and demo scheduling (first 2 calls), Redwood owns commercial follow-up and renewal. Label flow: `si-intake` -> `shared-nurture` -> `redwood-opportunity`.
Devon Lee: Edge case: if account was previously owned by Redwood AE and SI now claims, how do we prevent churn/conflict? Suggest: require a claim note with prior-owner and a 48h notice window where prior owner can object. If object, escalate to manager.
Samir Patel: For automation, I sketched a minimal commands set for partners: `/si-claim --si="name" --acct=ACCTID --role=pre-demo --note="referral"` and `/si-release --acct=ACCTID`. We can surface these in the marketplace UI for partner AEs.
claims-bot: claim-processor: Received claim ACCTID-7701 from acme-integrator, status=pending.
Maria Chen: Good. Add a `no-demo` flag for accounts with compliance or NDA hold so SI can't demo until cleared. Also require SI to attach an initial discovery doc or calendar invite link within 24h of claiming.
Tia Gomez: Can someone own reconciliations? I need a CSV export of claims by Friday to match against the co-announce list. Fields: acct, si_name, claim_ts, claim_role, prior_owner, status, note.
Devon Lee: I'll add a webhook that pushes claim events to the SI CRM and our internal reconcile endpoint. It will emit JSON lines and we can also export CSV.
Samir Patel: I'll implement an auto-assign for stale pending claims: after 36h move to regional AE, after 7d mark as orphan and ping partnerships for redistribution.
James Park: Approvals: 1) 36h -> regional AE, 2) 48h prior-owner reclaim window, 3) manager approval on contested claims. Any blockers?
Tia Gomez: None from enablement. Request: please include a history log per claim visible in Confluence so we can audit handoffs during the announcement.
Maria Chen: Action items: Devon add webhook + CSV endpoint; Samir add auto-assign timers (36h/7d) + `no-demo` enforcement; James publish contested-claim escalation matrix; Tia will run reconcile and share CSV on Thu.
Samir Patel: I'll also add a lightweight UI badge `marketplace-claimed` so marketplace listings show SI partner on the account.
claims-bot: claim-processor: event=webhook_registered for endpoint https://hooks.redwood/internal/claims/reconcile
Devon Lee: I'll mock a sample payload for Tia to validate CSV fields by EOD.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. If we can get these in place before the announcement we'll avoid duplicate demos and ensure SI credit shows up correctly. Post the Confluence link when ready. :party-parrot:
